paper_title: Context Consistency between Training and Testing in Simultaneous Machine   Translation
caption: : Wait-k Policy
model_annotation: The figure illustrates the relationship between BLEU score and Average Lagging (AL) for three different consistency approaches in simultaneous machine translation. The x-axis represents Average Lagging (AL) with a linear scale, ranging from 0 to 8, and is labeled at intervals of 2. The y-axis represents the BLEU score, also on a linear scale, ranging from 20 to 30, and is labeled at intervals of 2. Three dashed lines are plotted on the graph, each representing a different consistency approach: Consistency-CE (blue), Consistency-Bi + sampling (orange), and Consistency-Bi + beam (green). The lines are marked with distinct shapes: circles for Consistency-CE, triangles for Consistency-Bi + sampling, and squares for Consistency-Bi + beam. The legend in the lower center of the graph maps the color and shape of each line to its corresponding label. As Average Lagging increases from 0 to 8, the BLEU scores for all three approaches increase, with Consistency-CE starting at around 19 and reaching approximately 29, Consistency-Bi + sampling starting at around 24 and reaching about 29, and Consistency-Bi + beam starting at around 23 and reaching about 30.
